performanceCaveat: Processing widths reduce detail before output is upscaled. Inference timing alone is not total camera latency. See live camera verification for measured frame age; this is not calibrated glass-to-glass latency.
aswinAdaptation: Latest prediction from six past/current frames, original latest timestamp; no future wait. CUDA graph replay for ASwin and ShiftNet, fresh-input parity with eager inference verified.
temporalPolicy: Real consecutive capture history in owned buffers, genuine original selected-frame timestamp, newest pending request, no retimestamping, explicit raw fallback; research results older than 450 ms are rejected at native delivery to leave preview overhead within the requested 500 ms frame-age target
vidennConversion: Exact inference-layer translation; official weights; numerical TensorFlow parity test retained
